_comment: Shared VIN-brain pricing defaults for all layers (Layer 1 talking intake, Layer 2 VIN-to-anything, Layer 3 shop ops, Layer 4 sellable API). API prices are the per-lookup defaults Pedro will change later. Customer quote ranges are defaults / placeholders only — Pedro sets the real ranges; the chat intake shows them as typical ranges, never as a final price. The web app reads this copy from apps/web/src because Vercel only builds apps/web (rootDirectory apps/web) — a copy at the repo root is not in the deployment.
